summary: Audited all 19 extensions' index-entries.json (470 entries) against the 3 contradictory schema authorities. Confirmed load_when.languages/skills are dead at runtime (only referenced in validate-context-budgets.sh's dead-entry guard); task_types is the dominant live key (168/470 entries) yet forbidden by index.schema.json. Confirmed 24 core entries are reachable only via the meta catch-all, Tier-1 always-load is 996L (2x the 500L target), project-overview.md double-loads, and 7/19 EXTENSION.md files exceed 60 lines. Produced a concrete migration map and a new check-extension-docs.sh Rule T design (advisory-first, promote to hard after migration).
decisions_made: Standardize entries on summary/line_count/keywords/topics; retire description/tags (fold description detail into summary per-entry, not a blind rename)
Extend load_when to allow task_types; delete languages and skills entirely; migrate languages values 1:1 to task_types using each extension's own manifest.json routing keys
Do not add a hand-authored tier field; derive tier algorithmically in validate-context-budgets.sh from existing load_when shape instead
New check-extension-docs.sh Rule T (check_index_entries_schema) should default advisory via the existing INDEX_TRUTH_GATE_MODE variable, promoted to hard only after the 14-extension migration lands

Declared file_scope (3 files) undercounts the real edit surface; recommend Phase A (schema+standard+advisory check) as this task's deliverable, with Phases B-E (migration, meta catch-all, Tier-1 demotion, EXTENSION.md trims) spawned as follow-on tasks
